Xhev/se5 f1:1.en: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying: Consecrate to me every firstborn among the Israelites, of humans and of cattle, they are mine. Moses said to the people, Remember this day when you went out from Egypt, from a house of slaves, for by strength of hand YHWH brought you out from this place, and you shall not eat leavened bread. This day you are
Xhev/se5 f1:1.notes: Uncertain fragments: firstborn [positions 12,14], Egypt [position 39], strength [position 45], day [position 58]. Omitted untranslatable characters: ׃ [positions 8,23,56].

Xhev/se5 f1:2.en: Those going out in the month of Abib: the firstborn of every womb. And it was when YHWH brought you into the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, whom he swore to your fathers to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, that you should perform this service in this month. Seven days.
Xhev/se5 f1:2.notes: Position 39 (זבת) is glossed as "flow" but appears as a participle modifying "land" (ארץ). Positions 51-53 (חדש הזה) repeat the earlier month reference (positions 3-5) but lack a preposition; translated as an appositive. Position 55 (שבעת#) is marked uncertain in the source.

Xhev/se5 f1:3.en: You shall eat matzo on the seventh day, a festival of YHWH. Matzo shall be eaten for seven days, and no leaven shall be seen by you, nor leaven in all your territory. And you shall report to your son on that day because of this, which YHWH made for me when I went out from Egypt. And it was to you for a sign upon your hands.
Xhev/se5 f1:3.notes: Positions 1-2, 5-7, 8-10, 12-13, 15-17, 19-21, 26-28, 36-38, and 42-48 are supported by repeated phrase evidence. Positions 42 and 56 are uncertain due to damage. Position 11 and 30, 49 are untranslatable punctuation marks.

Xhev/se5 f1:4.en: And for a reminder between your eyes, so that the instruction of YHWH may be in your mouth, for by a strong hand YHWH brought you out from Egypt. And you shall keep this regulation for the appointed days, from days of old. And it shall be when YHWH brings you into the land of the Canaanite, as he swore to you.
Xhev/se5 f1:4.notes: Uncertainty in the transcription affects the translation of positions 12 (mouth), 43 (Canaanite), and 47 (to you).

Xhev/se5 f1:5.en: And to your fathers you gave it. And you shall pass every firstborn of a womb to YHWH, and every firstborn of a litter of cattle that will be male is to YHWH. And every firstborn of a donkey you will redeem with a sheep, and if you do not redeem it, you will break its neck, and every firstborn of a human among your sons you will redeem. And it will be that?
Xhev/se5 f1:5.notes: The final word is uncertain due to damage in the source text.

Xhev/se5 f1:6.en: Your son will ask you tomorrow, 'What do you mean by this?' and 'By what strength of hand did YHWH bring us out of Egypt?' Pharaoh was hardened against sending us out, and YHWH killed every firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of humankind to the firstborn of cattle. Therefore I sacrifice to YHWH.
Xhev/se5 f1:6.notes: Uncertain elements: 'to' (position 10), 'strength' (position 12), 'hand' (position 13), 'go out' (position 14), 'kill' (position 27), 'first-born' (position 30). Phrase evidence supports 'YHWH from Egypt,' 'by strength of hand,' 'firstborn of humankind,' 'I [am] sacrificing,' 'the land of Egypt,' 'the land of Egypt from,' 'in the land of Egypt,' and 'every firstborn.'

Xhev/se5 f1:7.en: Every firstborn of a womb, male, and every firstborn of sons I will buy off. And it will be a sign upon your hand and marks between your eyes, that by strength of hand Yahweh brought us out from Egypt.
Xhev/se5 f1:7.notes: Positions 10, 13, 15, 17, and 30 are uncertain. Position 11 is unknown.

Xhev/se5 f1:8.en: Hear, Israel, YHWH is one. And love YHWH your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your might. And these words that I am commanding you today shall be upon your heart. And you shall repeat them to your son and speak of them when you sit in your house and when you walk.
Xhev/se5 f1:8.notes: Uncertainty in the transcription affects positions 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 14, 15, 16, 17, 31, and 38. Phrase evidence supports the renderings 'with all heart,' 'with all being,' 'with all strength,' 'all strength,' 'I [am] commanding,' 'which I [am] commanding,' and 'these which I.'

Xhev/se5 f1:9.en: In your way, and in your lying down, and in your rising up. And you tied them for signs upon your hands, and they will be for marks between your eyes. And you wrote them upon the door-posts.
Xhev/se5 f1:9.notes: The phrase 'marks between eyes' is supported by repeated phrase evidence. The phrase 'they will be for marks' is also supported by repeated phrase evidence. The phrase 'a sign on hand' has partial support from repeated phrase evidence, but the context suggests 'for signs upon your hands' as a more coherent rendering.

Xhev/se5 f1:10.en: your house and at your gate and it will be if you hear you will hear to the commandments which I command
Xhev/se5 f1:10.notes: Uncertainty in the reconstruction of 'א#נ?ו?כ#י?' (I) and 'אש#ר#' (which) is reflected in the translation. The phrase 'commandments which I command' is supported by repeated phrase evidence.

Xhev/se5 f1:11.en: You the day to love Yahweh your God and to work with all heart
Xhev/se5 f1:11.notes: Uncertain transcription and reconstruction in positions 1, 2, 3, 5, 14, 15. Phrase evidence supports 'with all heart' (positions 12-14), 'the day' (positions 1-3), and 'Yahweh your God' (positions 6-8). No recoverable text for positions 15.

Xhev/se5 f1:12.en: Your earth in the time of early rain and spring-rain, you gathered corn and wine and Izhar/oil. And I gave herb in the field.
Xhev/se5 f1:12.notes: Uncertain elements include the transcription of 'יור#ה#' (early rain) and 'ד##ג?נ׳ך' (corn). The translation of 'יצהר׳ך' as 'Izhar/oil' reflects the lexical gloss provided.

Xhev/se5 f1:13.en: To your cattle and you ate and were sated. Take heed to lest it be spacious your heart.
Xhev/se5 f1:13.notes: The phrase 'take heed to' is supported by repeated phrase evidence. The verb 'יפתה' is translated as 'be spacious' based on the provided lexical gloss, though it may also mean 'seduce' in other contexts.

Xhev/se5 f1:14.en: You turned aside and served other gods and bowed down

Xhev/se5 f1:15.en: to them and it burned the anger of Yahweh in and he restrained
Xhev/se5 f1:15.notes: The phrase 'it burned the anger of Yahweh' is supported by repeated phrase evidence. The object marker 'את' is omitted as it does not contribute to the translation. The preposition 'to' is retained as it is the only recoverable word for the first position.

Xhev/se5 f2:1.en: The heavens and not it will be rain and the soil not it will yield produce and you have caused them to perish in haste from upon the earth
Xhev/se5 f2:1.notes: Uncertain transcription at positions 8, 9, 19, 20. Phrase evidence supports 'not it will be rain' and 'it will yield produce'.

Xhev/se5 f2:2.en: The good which Yahweh has given you, and you have put these words upon your hearts and upon your souls
Xhev/se5 f2:2.notes: Uncertainty in the transcription affects 'given' (ל׳כ#ם#), 'have put' (ש#מ##ת##ם##), and 'words' (דבר##׳י). The phrase 'good which Yahweh' is supported by repeated evidence, while 'Yahweh he has given' and 'give to' are less dominant patterns.

Xhev/se5 f2:3.en: And you will tie them as a sign upon your hand, and they will be for marks between your eyes. And you taught them, their sons, to speak.
Xhev/se5 f2:3.notes: Uncertainty in the transcription is reflected in the translation of 'a sign' and 'marks'. The phrase 'you taught them, their sons' is a reconstruction based on the provided evidence.

Xhev/se5 f2:4.en: In your sitting in the house and in your walking in the way and in your lying down and in your arising, write them upon the doorposts your house.

Xhev/se5 f2:5.notes: Uncertain elements include the verb 'increase' (position 6), the phrase 'days of your' (position 7), and the word 'sons' (position 10). The phrase 'which he swore to Yahweh' is supported by repeated phrase evidence.
